title: A section's words as a matter-js pile, drawn by the DOM
summary: List items as matter-js bodies (pills chamfered by half their height, blocks by `6` px, circles) dropped from a seeded order into a walled box when `30 %` of it is in view; `Engine.update(engine, 1000 / 60)` on the shared ticker through an accumulator capped at `4` steps, gravity `2.4`, `sleepThreshold 40`, each body's position and angle written to its own `<li>` as a `transform` so the words stay text in source order; the step leaves the ticker when every body sleeps and wakes on a press, a key or a `ResizeObserver` change that rebuilds the walls; `MouseConstraint` scoped to the box on fine pointers with its wheel and touch listeners removed, Enter / Space toss (`vy −14`) and ← / → push on real buttons, tap to toss on touch; no engine under reduced motion, the list wrapped upwards from the floor in CSS
variants: seeded drop into a walled box, drag on fine pointers, toss and push from the keyboard and by tap (full tier)
no engine, the list wrapped upwards from the floor with a fixed tilt per piece (reduced / static / no script)
loader: the same engine under a full-screen layer with SVG hull bodies, torn down after the hand-off (README)
